Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1130
Claimant:
Kathleen Garcia
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
6 Apr 2024
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a traffic
signal. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's
office.
16 Apr 2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and that coverage was in force at the time of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
12 May 2024
Photos of the rear bumper and trunk area were obtained from the insured and the claimant's side. They confirm
several details of the impact, but no independent witnesses have come forward.
3 Jun 2024
Vehicle damage appears mostly consistent with the impact described by both parties. No prior damage to the vehicle
is known from our records or from the repair shop's preliminary notes.
12 Jun 2024
Claimant's account of the collision was given in a recorded statement and again in a follow-up call through counsel.
The same sequence of events was described each time.
23 Jun 2024
Medical records received show the wrist fracture and a course of treatment that followed a typical pattern, tapering off
as the claimant improved. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
24 Jun 2024
Prior records show a small strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully. Requested further imaging
history to determine whether it bears on the current findings.
30 Jun 2024
Still unclear from the statements and photos exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at impact. Asked
counsel to clarify the seating position in writing.
31 Jul 2024
Sent a letter to counsel requesting the outstanding medical bills, the proir treatment records, and the claimant's
employment information for the wage loss portion of the claim.
22 Sep 2024
Claim remains open pending receipt of the requested records and the mediacl review. Next step is to schedule an
independent medical review once the prior treatment file arrives.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
